walkthrough.title: Price i is the low of every stretch that starts after the previous smaller price and ends before the next smaller-or-equal one. That's left × right stretches.

steps.text: 3 is the low of 1 × 1 = 1 stretches: adds 3. Total 3.
1 is the low of 2 × 3 = 6 stretches: adds 6. Total 9.
2 is the low of 1 × 2 = 2 stretches: adds 4. Total 13.
4 is the low of 1 × 1 = 1 stretches: adds 4. Total 17.
